report_name: Federal Cyber Rules Burden Industry with Duplicative Reporting: GAO

identities.name: U.S. Government Accountability Office
identities.description: Author of the report (GAO-26-108606) that found federal cybersecurity regulations are overlapping and burdensome for the private sector.

identities.name: Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency
identities.description: U.S. federal agency preparing to implement new rules under the Cyber Incident Reporting for Critical Infrastructure Act of 2022 (CIRCIA), which the GAO warns could add to regulatory complexity.

identities.name: Office of the National Cyber Director
identities.description: U.S. federal office designated to lead the effort to harmonize and streamline federal cybersecurity regulations, urged by the GAO to accelerate these efforts.

identities.name: U.S. Critical Infrastructure Operators
identities.description: Private sector organizations across 16 U.S. critical infrastructure sectors identified by the GAO as being burdened by duplicative and overlapping federal cybersecurity reporting requirements.
